scope.title: Re-verify A6 long-running-persistence controlled pilot gate

decision.reason: All six A6 criteria are now verified: ResumeContractVerifier (rollback -> requiresReverification), FingerprintLeaseCoordinator (lease-before-checkpoint) and the 10-cycle pause/resume p99 are implemented in openclaw_runtime/src/agents/cross-area/cross-area-facades.ts and covered by tests/unit/cross-area-composition.test.ts, tests/unit/deep/a6-deep.test.ts and tests/unit/performance-budgets.test.ts.

criterion6_budgetAction.threshold: volatile mislabel OR fail rate >5% -> degrade_to_full_reverification
